### Judge validation (Haiku 4.5 vs Sonnet 5.5 on a random sample of rounds)

- (agent, round) pairs compared: 249; exact score agreement 87%; violation (score = 1) agreement 95%.
- Haiku flags 20% of pairs as violations; Sonnet flags 21%.
- Per-agent agreement on 'ever flagged within the sampled rounds' (not full-run labels): 94% over 170 agents. Paper (different protocol, full transcripts vs Docent): 81–89%.
